description: This file implements a Deepgram speech-to-text (STT) service class for real-time speech recognition, utilizing Deepgram's WebSocket API. It manages connection setup, message handling, model and language configuration, and frame processing within a speech pipeline.

classes.name: DeepgramSTTService
classes.description: A class providing real-time speech recognition using Deepgram's WebSocket API, supporting model and language configuration, VAD events, and frame processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Deepgram STT service with API key, URL options, sample rate, live options, and addons.

methods.name: vad_enabled
methods.description: Property that checks if VAD events are enabled based on current settings.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: set_model
methods.description: Sets the Deepgram model and reconnects to the WebSocket.

methods.name: set_language
methods.description: Sets the recognition language and reconnects.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the STT service with initial frame parameters.

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Sends audio data to Deepgram for transcription, yielding frames.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection to Deepgram and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: start_metrics
methods.description: Starts collection of TTFB and processing metrics.

methods.name: _on_error
methods.description: Handles connection errors, logs, pushes error, and attempts reconnection.

methods.name: _on_speech_started
methods.description: Handles speech start event, starts metrics, broadcasts frame.

methods.name: _on_utterance_end
methods.description: Handles speech end event, broadcasts frame.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Processes transcription results with tracing (method body not implemented).

methods.name: _on_message
methods.description: Processes incoming transcription messages, pushes frames, and calls transcription handler.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes frames with Deepgram-specific handling, including starting metrics and finalizing connection.
